report.summary: Patient P-D007 (age 66, Original Medicare, no transport benefit) has a confirmed transportation need per the 10/23/2026 screener and lives in tract 17031681000, a low-income area with high no-vehicle share (45%) but strong transit coverage. The best-fit option is Senior Shuttle West (free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM–5 PM), for which the patient is age-eligible. RideWell Medical Transport offers an eligibility check but requires an external system query not available here. Medicaid Ride Line is not applicable (patient has Medicare, not Medicaid). ADA paratransit is a longer-term option requiring certification (up to 21 days) with eligibility undetermined.

options.how_to_access: For Medicaid plan members only; call the number on the card at least 2 business days ahead. Not applicable — patient has Original Medicare.

options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days. Eligibility undetermined without disability information.
